title: Financial Literacy Camp
summary: Financial Literacy Camp for the student community held on Tuesday, September 1st at Ravikiran Vidyalaya Parksite, Vikhroli for classes V111, IX and X . 80 students participated.
description:
Financial Literacy Camp for the student community held on Tuesday, September 1st at Ravikiran Vidyalaya Parksite, Vikhroli for classes V111, IX and X .
80 students participated.

Suryodaya Foundation , our implementation partner for the project made an engaging and interactive presentation on the subject - the objective of this sesssion was to educate them on the relation between financial and physical health on subjects like importance budgeting and Saving for health and financial emergencies,digital literacy, banking products and services etc.

Rtn,Savita Govilkar helped us in getting permissions for this outreach.

This session will be followed by a another session with parents too
location: Ravikiran Vidyalaya Parksite, Vikhroli, Mumbai, Maharashtra
